verdict.rationale: Viam is a platform with fleet, machine, and data APIs, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are fair questions to ask of it. The evidence pack documents neither versioned API endpoints nor a deprecation policy. The versioning evidence it does contain covers module and ML-model deployment (versioning, staging, canary rollouts, rollbacks), and the stable GetImage() interface is about hardware abstraction. Both are adjacent capabilities, not API lifecycle guarantees.
